fields.game_text: Exact string the game passes to VoiceSystem.say(). The key that maps a clip to its line. Do not change it here without changing story.js.
fields.tts_text: What to synthesise: the same words plus ElevenLabs v3 delivery tags in [square brackets]. Voice only, no sound effects.
fields.bake_tags: Sounds that MAY be baked into the clip (radio lines only). If baked, set radioBaked: true in the manifest so the engine skips its own squelch and static.
fields.tts_text_full: bake_tags + tts_text: the prompt for a clip that carries its own radio squelch and static.
fields.engine_sfx: Sounds the game engine already plays during and right after the line. Context for the performance only. NEVER bake them, they would play twice.
fields.script_text: The whole moment in brackets (engine sounds + delivery + words), for reading, casting and table reads; not a TTS prompt.
fields.channel: radio = heard through a police radio; body-mic = the wearer, closest voice; distant-outdoor = shouted from 4 to 7 m in the rain.
fields.max_seconds: Hard cap on clip length where the timing of the scene depends on it (null = no cap).
fields.est_seconds: Duration the game currently assumes for the subtitle; a real clip replaces it with its own length.

dispatch.subtitle: DISPATCH
dispatch.brief: Keston City PD night dispatcher. Woman, mid-40s, American (Midwest), warm alto. Practised, flat radio cadence, clipped and efficient. The calm only cracks at the very end.

officer.subtitle: OFC. HALLORAN
officer.brief: Patrol officer, man, late 30s, American, baritone. Dry, understated, tired from a night shift. Under pressure becomes breathless and raw; after the bite progressively weaker and slurred. He wears the camera, so he is the closest voice in every scene.

swat.subtitle: SWAT
swat.brief: Man, 40s, big chest voice, commanding. Shouting across 4 to 7 m of rainy courtyard. Also voices END-10 over his radio.

swat2.subtitle: SWAT
swat2.brief: Man, late 20s, higher tenor, tense, on the edge of panic.

radio.subtitle: RADIO
radio.brief: Same actor as SWAT ONE, heard through a police radio.

scenes.title: Intro: the drive (evidence playback)
scenes.context: Inside patrol car 21-A-14, 03:13 a.m., heavy rain, wipers, lights and siren (code 3). The bodycam's 30 s pre-event buffer ends with a double beep and audio cuts in. Radio traffic plays while the car waits at a red light, then turns into the Harlan Court lot.

scenes.title: Lobby
scenes.context: Halloran enters the dark apartment-block lobby through a glass door. Fluorescent tubes buzz and flicker.

scenes.title: Apartment 1C: the bite
scenes.context: A figure crouches over the building superintendent, feeding. Halloran confronts it at gunpoint; it lunges and bites his left forearm during a struggle. After the fight the victim gets back up.

scenes.title: Checkpoint 1 restart
scenes.context: Only heard when the player restarts from checkpoint 1 (after the bite): a one-line reminder of the objective.

scenes.title: Maintenance room
scenes.context: A shotgun lies on the workbench.

scenes.title: Courtyard finale: hold until SWAT arrives
scenes.context: Rear courtyard in the rain, waves of infected pouring in, continuous gunfire. Dispatch counts down on the radio (lines fire at 0, 40, 70 and 95 s).

scenes.title: Ending: the gate
scenes.context: SWAT van in the alley, siren and red/blue lights. Two SWAT officers with rifle lights hold the gate. The infection takes Halloran mid-conversation; SWAT fires; the camera falls to the ground and records the aftermath.
